title: Qixian Decoction Improves Airway Hyperresponsiveness by Inhibiting TRPV1 and Downstream PI3K-Akt/HIF-1alpha Signaling.
authors: Zhu, Linyun; Yang, Wei; Chen, Qingge; Wang, Xiongbiao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药启陷汤通过TRPV1/PI3K-Akt/HIF-1alpha通路改善哮喘气道高反应性，仅涉及分子对接验证化合物-靶点结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Qixian Decoction (QXT), a traditional Chinese medicine formula, exerts favorable therapeutic effects on asthma, but its underlying mechanisms remain incompletely elucidated. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This study combined network pharmacology and experimental validation. Employing the Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology Database and Analysis Platform (TCMSP), we screened active compounds of QXT and their targets. A herbcompound- target network was constructed. DEGs were recognized from the GSE161245 asthma dataset. Molecular docking was utilized to validate the interaction of key compounds with selected core targets. The effects of QXT on the Potential Vanilloid 1 (TRPV1)/Phosphatidylinositol 3-Kinase-Protein Kinase B (PI3K-Akt)/Hypoxia-Inducible Factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha) axis and Epithelial- Mesenchymal Transition (EMT) were evaluated using in vivo (asthmatic mice) and in vitro (TGF-beta-stimulated 16HBE cells) models. RESULTS: A total of 83 active compounds and 308 potential targets were identified, with significant enrichment observed in the PI3K-Akt pathway. Key targets (IGF1R, CDK6, and EGFR) were positively correlated with TRPV1. Luteolin, quercetin, and EGCG stably bind to their targets. QXT suppressed TRPV1, p-AKT, and HIF-1alpha, and ameliorated airway hyperresponsiveness and EMT in vivo and in vitro. DISCUSSION: QXT could alleviate asthma airway hyperresponsiveness and remodeling by inhibiting the TRPV1/PI3K-Akt/HIF-1alpha axis and EMT. The active compounds potentially exerted their therapeutic effects through multi-target mechanisms. CONCLUSION: QXT alleviated asthma airway remodeling and hyperresponsiveness via suppressing the TRPV1/PI3K-Akt/HIF-1alpha signaling axis and EMT, providing a scientific basis for its clinical application.
abstract_zh: 引言：芪仙汤（QXT）作为一种传统中药方剂，对哮喘具有良好治疗效果，但其潜在机制尚未完全阐明。材料与方法：本研究结合网络药理学与实验验证。利用中药系统药理学数据库与分析平台（TCMSP），筛选了QXT的活性化合物及其靶点。构建了草药-化合物-靶点网络。从GSE161245哮喘数据集中识别出差异表达基因（DEGs）。采用分子对接验证关键化合物与选定核心靶点的相互作用。通过体内（哮喘小鼠）和体外（TGF-β刺激的16HBE细胞）模型，评估了QXT对潜在香草酸受体1（TRPV1）/磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶-蛋白激酶B（PI3K-Akt）/缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1α）轴及上皮-间质转化（EMT）的影响。结果：共鉴定出83种活性化合物和308个潜在靶点，其中PI3K-Akt通路显著富集。关键靶点（IGF1R、CDK6和EGFR）与TRPV1呈正相关。木犀草素、槲皮素和EGCG能稳定结合其靶点。QXT抑制了TRPV1、p-AKT和HIF-1α，并在体内和体外改善了气道高反应性和EMT。讨论：QXT可能通过抑制TRPV1/PI3K-Akt/HIF-1α轴及EMT来缓解哮喘气道高反应性和重塑。活性化合物可能通过多靶点机制发挥其治疗作用。结论：QXT通过抑制TRPV1/PI3K-Akt/HIF-1α信号轴及EMT，减轻了哮喘气道重塑和高反应性，为其临床应用提供了科学依据。
